description: The file defines the `MetaService` class within the `Api\V8\Service` namespace. It provides API endpoints for retrieving module and field metadata, as well as a Swagger schema. It interacts with other components like BeanManager and ModuleListProvider to access module definitions and user permissions.

classes.name: MetaService
classes.description: Provides API services to retrieve module list, field list, and Swagger schema for the SuiteCRM metadata.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules in the system.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Returns a list of fields for a specified module, considering user access.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasModuleAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access a specific module; throws exception if not.

methods.name: buildFieldList
methods.description: Constructs a list of field definitions for a module, applying access checks.

methods.name: pruneVardef
methods.description: Filters the full field definition to only include allowed fields for API exposure.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Loads and returns the Swagger JSON schema for API documentation; throws if not found or unreadable.
